_comment: Phase 0 measurements template. Fill every field per run. Do not reuse one timer's output under two different metric names — see methodology fields.

clean_vm_confirmed_absent.notes: Testing executed on host Windows 11 build environment with bundled standalone artifacts; dedicated isolated clean VM snapshot was unavailable. Standalone execution verified with embedded runtime.

build.frontend_build_command: npm --prefix frontend run check && npm --prefix frontend run build

methodology.cold_start_to_health_ok: Spawns fresh backend subprocess after cold wait, polls GET http://127.0.0.1:24823/health every 20ms using urllib.request until HTTP 200 is received, then immediately terminates process. Repeated for 5 runs.
methodology.warm_start_to_health_ok: Immediately relaunches backend subprocess on warm OS disk cache, polls GET http://127.0.0.1:24823/health every 20ms until HTTP 200 is received, then terminates process. Repeated for 5 runs.
methodology.health_roundtrip_only: Backend process is kept running and warm; sends 5 independent HTTP GET /health requests measuring client-side round-trip time (perf_counter before request to after response body read).

defender_scan.scanner_used: Windows Defender Antimalware Command Line Utility (MpCmdRun.exe)

failures.description: Windows 11 SmartAppControl blocked locally compiled unsigned test executables during ad-hoc build (os error 4551)
failures.root_cause: Host OS has SmartAppControl enabled in enforce mode, blocking unsigned binaries without cloud reputation
failures.resolution: Bundled standalone backend with PyInstaller incorporating standard bootloader metadata; documented Authenticode code signing certificate requirement for release

failures.description: Initial measurement script reused single startup timer for both backend_startup_seconds and health_response_seconds (reported as 3.98s)
failures.root_cause: Benchmark script measure_phase0.py assigned health_response_time variable to both fields
failures.resolution: Implemented backend/tests/audit_measurements.py with distinct timers: 5-run cold start, 5-run warm start, and 5-run isolated HTTP roundtrip

fallback.trigger_condition: Failure of Phase 0 packaging gate or persistent unresolvable distribution blocker
fallback.decision_point: Phase 0 validation audit completed with all requirements passing
